findings.title: NFR: runtime startup cost acknowledged without a target
findings.description: The architecture HLD notes SDK agent initialization cost (20-30s for Claude SDK subprocess spawn) as a design consideration. The design discusses the analogous Codex app-server subprocess startup cost, states no latency target is set (justified: dominated by the agentic turn, bounded by `turn_timeout_s`), confines spawning to three explicit places, and logs startup duration at DEBUG for diagnosability. The architecture does not state a specific NFR target for this path, so no target is restated; the acknowledgment and the bounding timeout are proportionate.
